provenance.notes: Free keys are for personal, non-commercial sites only; a commercial site needs a paid plan, "any plan other than Personal" (terms, 1 and 3): commercial use declared as "contract". Each paid plan has an API usage limit, a number of spam checks a month (on 2026-11-10: Pro 500 to 2,000 a month for 1 to 4 sites, Business 5,000 with unlimited sites, Enterprise custom); the pricing page says the protection keeps working when a site occasionally goes over, and the terms that Automattic may restrict or throttle the calls above it: not a hard limit, and it depends on the site's plan, so the rate limits are left unknown (a site declares its plan's figure as a tightening). Personal plans: pay what you can, no figure published. Caching, storing and redistributing the answers are not addressed. Nothing to credit (the terms ask a credit only for reusing their own text).
